Definition: to bear in mind, i.e. hope
BiblicalUsage: çᵉbar is simply to bear in mind, to hope. Scripture uses it in Daniel, and the context leaves nothing to guess at.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that çᵉbar is no exception: no word in Scripture is filler.
